name: Jeeter | Sugar Plum | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Sugar Plum is a sweet and earthy sativa with just a hint of sour to round out its bold flavor profile. Fruity, fragrant, and full of personality, this strain delivers a layered sensory experience from start to finish. Life’s a little sweeter with Sugar Plum in the mix.
